text.p: These are the main headlines of the news reported by Radio Latvia on Tuesday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
- Another victim of the Talsi firefighting show accident at the end of June, a seven-year old boy, died in hospital, bringing the death toll to nine.
- Prime Minister Andris Shkele will not resign and presented a plan of settling conflicts within his seven-party coalition government.

- Shkele called on the parties to nominate candidates for the vacant ministerial posts this week and suggested an extraordinary parliament session to be called on August 6 to vote on the new ministers.
